title: Ex 1.4 #11 · {X ⊆ 𝒫({1, 2, 3}) : |X| ≤ 1}
prompt: Write $\{X \subseteq \mathscr{P}(\{1, 2, 3\}) : |X| \le 1\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.

mistakes.hint: Those are the elements of 𝒫({1, 2, 3}) with at most one element. Here X ⊆ 𝒫({1, 2, 3}): each X is a set of subsets.

hints: Here X is a subset of 𝒫({1, 2, 3}), so X is a set whose elements are subsets of {1, 2, 3}.
X has at most one element: either X = ∅, or X = {Y} for one subset Y of {1, 2, 3}.
solution: X = ∅ works, and so does X = {Y} for each of the 8 subsets Y of {1, 2, 3}: 9 elements in all.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
